items.title: 71231_Sam Wooding Oral History Interview
items.q: this dancer was as good as Bill Robinson.

ctx.x: Y-o-n-d-e-r. Wait a minute, what was his name? I can't think of his name now. But, this dancer was as good as Bill Robinson. But he made one mistake. He went into -- he left for Waterville to go for the burlesque. And burlesque is a step below vaudeville.. See, instead of going up. So, anyhow, Dancing Dodson was his name. Dancing Dodson. Well, Dodson came to us and here was another experience that we had

that was very good, because he was working at the Regent Theater. And he heard about the band, so we had a nice little band there, so he come down one day to listen to the band and he was talking to Bricktop and a couple of other entertainers there. So he said, "How would you boys like to come on and try to -- have you ever been on stage?" We said "no we hadn't". So he said, "Well, I'll tell you what I'm going to do.
